Our stakeholders have aligned on timelines but need a firm go/no-go and signature window to lock procurement and the implementation calendar.

- Confirmation of: signing mechanism (DocuSign/e-sign), earliest available signature date, and tentative start date for onboarding (we prefer earliest possible in March).

Best,

Monica / Camila — looped in.

A few operational constraints to flag so we stay realistic:
1) Legal redlines — if Stellar requires more than the standard data-processing clause adjustments we typically need 48–72 hours to route (legal + compliance). I reviewed the MAP; nothing obvious so far but waiting on Stellar legal for confirmation.
2) Procurement — if they require a PO before DocuSign completes, that could push the payment-onboarding by a week. Procurement contact up top (procure@stellarsys.com) — we should confirm whether a PO is mandatory.
3) Dedicated capacity ramp — our onboarding runbook requires ~7 business days to provision and baseline dedicated GPU pools after signature and payment confirmation. That means a signature on Mar 5 would align to an operational start around Mar 16–17.

I've attached a short redline_summary.docx with items legal will watch. If Stellar confirms e-signature only, we can keep to the earlier timeline.

Karthik
Head of Platform Partnerships
Redwood Inference
